description: Unit tests for dynamic array functions

tests.name: dynarr_int_array_basic
tests.description: Basic int array operations - create, append, get, length

tests.name: dynarr_string_array_basic
tests.description: Basic string array operations - create, append, verify content

tests.name: dynarr_array_insert_remove
tests.description: Insert at various positions and remove, verify order preserved

tests.name: dynarr_array_split_join
tests.description: Split string into array and join back - roundtrip test

tests.name: dynarr_int_split_join
tests.description: Split string into int array and join back

tests.name: dynarr_array_stack_ops
tests.description: Stack operations - push/pop/peek with int array, verify LIFO

tests.name: dynarr_array_queue_ops
tests.description: Queue operations - enqueue/dequeue/peek with int array, verify FIFO

tests.name: dynarr_array_concat_slice
tests.description: Concatenate two arrays and slice a range, verify contents

tests.name: dynarr_array_empty_edge
tests.description: Empty array operations, NULL handling, out-of-bounds access

tests.name: dynarr_array_copy
tests.description: Copy array, verify contents match, modify copy doesn't affect original
